approved_scope: Owner-authorized Phase 2 trial only; RF-F003, RF-T005, RF-T006, RF-T007 unchanged. Phase 3 not approved.
description: RF-T007-equivalent max three variable C branches and each grounded DTC's separate permanent 0.5pF/Q40 parasitic, plus connection-dependent PCB_PATTERN_C: grounded fixed PCB-C 0.02..1.0pF/Q60; non-ground/hot-hot fixed PCB-C 0.02..0.2pF/Q40; up to 3 fixed PCB-C total.
validation_notes: Ground node=0 in shared validation API (remap circuit-local -1 to 0). Each fixed PCB_PATTERN_C attached to ground uses Q60 and C in [0.02,1.0]pF; every non-ground/hot-hot fixed PCB_PATTERN_C uses Q40 and C in [0.02,0.2]pF. Maximum total fixed PCB-C remains 3; physical PCB area not charged as chip area, not claimed zero footprint. The special per-grounded-DTC 0.5pF/Q40 branch from RF-T007 is separate, remains Q40, is NOT PCB_PATTERN_C, and does NOT consume the PCB_PATTERN_C count or its per-connection limits. DTC Q35, 0..3pF and max three branches unchanged. Frozen external source/output S2P, six bands, k, 30dB mandatory H2/H3, 35dB nominal target and 0.3dB IL target unchanged; RF-T006 3-6GHz extra condition NOT inherited. Connection-specific validator/admittance must be used explicitly; merely loading metadata does not restamp a legacy solver. A 0.831046dB result obtained using Q40 for ground Cg is an OLD trial result and is NOT an RF-T008 performance verification. Owner's 1pF manufacturability and Q60 are provisional engineering assumptions pending layout, EM and Q(f)/tolerance validation. Only Phase 2.
